pear.js

PEAR 的 robot station，TypeScript 瀏覽器版。非官方、實驗性質。

網頁第一版準備中。完成後，這個網址會是用 Chrome 接上 SO-101 手臂的網頁：讀取關節角度、顯示手腕相機的畫面、檢查模型服務。第一版只讀取，不會讓手臂動。

    PEAR's robot station in TypeScript, for the browser. Unofficial and experimental.

    The first version of the page is being prepared. When it is ready, this address will hold a page that connects Chrome to an SO-101 arm: it reads the joints, shows the wrist camera and checks the model service. The first version only reads; it does not move the arm.
